0022600002.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Philadelphia 76ers visit the New York Knicks, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the 76ers a 45% chance to win. The 76ers are without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles ruptured), Dominick Barlow (out, back) and Tacko Fall (out, hip), and Adem Bona (foot sprain), Anfernee Simons (hamstring) and Dean Wade (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while the Knicks have Josh Hart (ankle soreness) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2, and the Knicks won their most recent meeting 144-114 in the 2025-26 playoffs, which the 76ers lost 0-4.
